messages.subject: Upcoming events of the Davis R Users' Group
parts:
Hello, D-RUGgies!

Our regular meetings continue in the DataLab classroom (room 360 Shields Library) on Wednesdays 10-noon. Here is a list of the events we have planned for those meetings this quarter - let us know if have an idea you'd like to see added to the for the fall or winter quarter!

Tomorrow we have Liza Wood to teach us about making an R package!
Next week we have a paper discussion - this quarter we will discuss a back-and-forth from The R Journal about R's software engineering culture, compared to a data analysis culture. The papers are short but sweet, so we hope you'll have a chance to read them in  advance of the group meetings. Links are below!

Current presentation schedule: 
Sept 28: Brief intro to function writing and iteration (Liza) 
Oct 5: Creating a package (Liza) 
Oct 12: Paper discussion: Software Engineering and R Programming: A Call for Research
Oct 19: Making animated figures in R (Jesse)
Oct 26: Intro to web scraping (Liza)
Nov 2: Intro to text manipulation with regular expressions (Liza)
Nov 9: Paper discussion: We Need Trustworthy R Packages, The R Developer Community Does Have a Strong Software Engineering Culture, and The R Quest: from Users to Developers 
Nov 16: Shiny Apps (Tara)
Nov 23: -- Thanksgiving week -- 
Nov 30:
Dec 7: --  Finals week --
